dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: June 30th**

A day of thrilling performances across the league saw several players make their mark. Riley Greene led the charge with a dynamic double-double, tallying two home runs and three RBIs for the Detroit Tigers in their 9-3 win over the New York Yankees. Tarik Skubal backed him up with a strong outing on the mound, striking out nine batters in six innings of work.

Meanwhile, Jacob deGrom continued his dominance, fanning nine batters over seven innings as the Texas Rangers edged out the Cleveland Guardians 4-2. Joc Pederson provided the offense, blasting a home run and driving in two runs. Bobby Witt Jr. also made waves, hitting two home runs and driving in three runs for the Tampa Bay Rays in their 10-4 victory over the Kansas City Royals.

In other games, Cristopher Sánchez tossed a gem for the Philadelphia Phillies, striking out nine batters over seven scoreless innings as they pounded the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0. And Dansby Swanson led the Chicago Cubs to a 7-9 comeback win over the San Diego Padres, hitting two home runs and driving in three runs.
